title: Inline weekday chip
description: Collapses the weekday into a small uppercased, letter-spaced, chip-bordered token ("DOM") set inline before the day/month, so "Domingo" reads as a compact badge-like marker rather than competing for line length with "23 de agosto".

changes.intent: Expose a 3-letter uppercase weekday abbreviation alongside the existing day/month string.
changes.detail: Add formattedWeekdayCaps derived from toLocaleDateString('es-CR', { weekday: 'short' }) uppercased and stripped of trailing punctuation ('dom.' → 'DOM'), used alongside the existing 'day: numeric, month: long' string ('23 de agosto').

changes.intent: Render the weekday as a small chip before the day/month text, inline.
changes.detail: DOM23 de agosto, with .screen__clock-date set to display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px.

changes.intent: Style the weekday as a compact, bordered, letter-spaced chip distinct from the rest of the date text.
